questions.q: How should you treat the pay ranges quoted for data science roles?
options: As a compass that varies by city, employer, role mix and year
questions.explain: Ranges are broad signals from postings and reports; your market and the specific role determine the real number.

questions.q: In the total compensation example, why did Offer B (highest base) have the lowest total?
options: The other offers added bonus, retirement match and signing amounts on top of a lower base
Offer B had a lower base
questions.explain: Bonus, match and signing amounts added to Offers A and C; but bonuses are often targets and signing is one-time.

questions.q: What is a sensible response when an offer arrives?
options: Accept immediately to avoid losing it
Thank them, ask for a day or two, then make one clear counter with a reason
Threaten to walk away without meaning it
questions.explain: A calm, honest process with time to review and one reasoned counter is the common, low-risk approach.

questions.q: The base salary is firm. What else might you ask about?
options: Signing bonus, start date or a certification budget
Whether they will lower the base
questions.explain: Other pieces of the package can sometimes flex even when base pay does not.

questions.q: Which path is the better fit if you would rather build AI applications than models, according to the path overview?
questions.explain: The Data Scientist path notes that the AI Engineer path suits people who prefer building AI applications.
